Locations: for 922, the map each Vidyalaya embeds on its own Contact Us page (kv-locations.js; kv-contact-location-review.csv lists rejected embeds); for 133, OpenStreetMap matches (match-osm.js). Checked against each other for the 116 KVs with both, the two sources agree within 0.5 km for 83% (96) and within 2 km for 91% (105); kv-location-conflicts.csv lists the disagreements, which keep the OSM location until reviewed.
